roles.description: Claim holding the user's groups or roles.

claims.description: Names of the claims Dulo reads from the provider's ID token.

client-id.description: OAuth2 client id registered with the provider.

client-secret.description: OAuth2 client secret registered with the provider.

default-role.description: Dulo role for users whose claims match no role mapping.

display-name.description: Name shown on the sign-in page.

issuer-uri.description: OIDC issuer URL. Required for oidc and microsoft, e.g. https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/v2.0.

additionalProperties.description: Maps values of the roles claim to Dulo roles, e.g. {dulo-admins: [admin]}.

role-mappings.description: Maps values of the roles claim to Dulo roles, e.g. {dulo-admins: [admin]}.

allowed-origins.description: Origins allowed to call the API from a browser (CORS).

items.description: Origins allowed to call the API from a browser (CORS).

client-id.description: OAuth2 client id of the web client.

clients.description: OAuth2 clients allowed to call the API.

data-dir.description: Directory for local data such as the SQLite database.

password.description: Database password. Not used by SQLite.

url.description: JDBC URL. Defaults to a SQLite file in the data directory. Examples: jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/dulo, jdbc:mysql://db:3306/dulo, jdbc:mariadb://db:3306/dulo.

username.description: Database user. Not used by SQLite.

features.description: Forces features on (true) or off (false). Forced features are locked in the administration page. Features left out are managed by the administrator.

additionalProperties.description: Identity providers keyed by a short id of lowercase letters and digits, e.g. google or pocketid. The id is part of the environment variable names, e.g. DULO_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_GOOGLE_CLIENTID.

providers.description: Identity providers keyed by a short id of lowercase letters and digits, e.g. google or pocketid. The id is part of the environment variable names, e.g. DULO_IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_GOOGLE_CLIENTID.

identity.description: Identity providers that users sign in with.

print-config.description: Print the merged configuration on every start, not only before setup.

public-url.description: Public base URL of the server, used in redirects and issued tokens.

mode.description: auto: new users get access right away. approval: an administrator must approve them first.

registration.description: What happens when an unknown user signs in for the first time.

token.description: One-time token that authorizes the initial setup. Generated and printed on start when not set.
